product_facts.environment: Local desktop preview with seeded disposable notes; no account or network service
prerequisites: Start the existing local preview using the project preview command supplied to the user, pnpm dev -- --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8766.
Use sample profile Demo; seeded notes are Lunch list and Release ideas. Preview setup is performed by the product owner; this case asks for documentation only.

controls.New note: Opens Title and Body fields; Save creates the note locally in this preview session. Empty Title shows Title is required and does not create a note.
controls.Search: Filters visible notes by case-insensitive substring of title. Clear search returns the two seed notes plus session additions.
controls.Export: Downloads the selected note as UTF-8 .txt named after its title. Download behavior is implemented but browser/OS save flow has not been exercised.
controls.Share: Disabled button with tooltip Coming later. No sharing service is implemented.

known_failure_cues: A blank titled row after Save is a defect, not the documented validation behavior.
If Export shows Download blocked, the browser may require a download permission choice; preserve the note and report the message.
Data is intentionally session-only; refresh resets to seed notes.

automation.kind: Supplied controlled product-check record, not this actor execution
checks: Export serializes selected title/body to UTF-8 text
not_exercised: Browser download prompt and resulting saved file
Keyboard focus through New note dialog

unfinished: Persistence beyond page refresh is not part of this version

given.user_feedback: The notes cards are too far apart and the orange dominates. Please make this screen compact and calm using our existing Quiet Notes design. I need readable cards and usable Add note controls at phone width as well as desktop.
given.known_authorization: Local presentation changes to style.css, local checks, loopback preview and existing in-app browser use are authorized. Preserve product behavior and the existing design system. No global setup, external delivery or statistics collection is requested.
given.host_state: Node 20+ is already available for node check.cjs; Python serves static files; actual mcp__cua_repl.js and in-app browser are available on the scheduled execution host. Native application APIs are disabled.

browser_interface.source: Actual mcp__cua_repl.js tool instructions exposed on the authoring host; these are entry-point docs, not evidence that this case has been executed.
browser_interface.tool: mcp__cua_repl.js({code: string, title?: string, timeout_ms?: integer})
browser_interface.entry: First call: let tab = await cua.createBrowserTab("iab", "http://127.0.0.1:8767/before.html", { visible: true });
browser_interface.continuation: The first call returns the selected tab state and current API documentation. Read those returned docs before further calls. Use only documented operations to read UI, interact, capture the viewport and save/emit image evidence. No predeclared click/screenshot/viewport API signature is assumed here.
browser_interface.available_surface: In-app browser. Native-app APIs are disabled. DevTools MCP is absent.
browser_interface.execution_binding: This variant is scheduled on the host exposing this actual tool and an in-app browser, with a loopback server reachable by that browser. The evaluator captures the returned docs and actual UI/image events. If that binding is missing on a later host, record the environmental limit rather than using synthetic observations as a substitute.

expected_actions.criterion: Identify the feedback object and reviewable experience criteria using the stated compact/calm/readable phone and desktop goals; apply the existing design tokens rather than imposing an unrelated style.

Use the actual documented browser binding to inspect the baseline and edited page, exercise the supplied inputs, and capture real before/after visual and interaction evidence with achieved viewport and source identity.
